exemplars.title: Designing Human-AI Collaboration to Support Learning in Counterspeech Writing
exemplars.why: CounterQuill converts the user’s earlier reflections into a draft already occupying the writing artifact, then exposes ordinary add, edit, and delete operations on that content. This is the cleanest evidence of all three defining properties: a non-empty starting state, generated material in its final working location, and direct revision without an intervening acceptance step.
exemplars.over_the_runner_up: It edges out Synergi because the evidence explicitly names the in-place editing operations, whereas Synergi only says that users can iterate and customize the generated structure.

exemplars.title: Synergi: A Mixed-Initiative System for Scholarly Synthesis and Sensemaking
exemplars.why: Synergi begins scholarly synthesis with an entire generated hierarchy of threads and subthreads that users iteratively customize as their working structure. It is a particularly valuable exemplar because the prefilled artifact is structural rather than merely prose, demonstrating that the pattern can overcome cold starts in complex sensemaking work.
exemplars.over_the_runner_up: It ranks above ChainBuddy because the evidence establishes that users start with an entire generated artifact and continue iterating on that same structure, while ChainBuddy’s shorter description leaves the flow’s placement and initial interaction less explicit.

exemplars.title: ChainBuddy: An AI-assisted Agent System for Generating LLM Pipelines
exemplars.why: ChainBuddy supplies a use-case-specific starter pipeline as the editable working flow, which users can modify and extend directly. The example broadens the pattern from generated copy to executable artifacts: the template is not advice about a pipeline but the non-empty pipeline from which construction begins.
exemplars.over_the_runner_up: It is preferred over the peer-support reply system because it demonstrates the same mechanism in an editable executable structure, making the pattern’s range clearer than another comparatively familiar generated-message draft.

notes: The final selection retains the consensus top three; no score was adjusted by more than 0.3. The ordering favors structural fidelity plus coverage across prose, hierarchical sensemaking, and executable pipelines. Readers should be cautious that each pick rests on a single quoted passage: CounterQuill provides strong evidence of concrete edit operations, but Synergi and ChainBuddy do not enumerate their UI controls or explicitly rule out a separate acceptance gate. Their wording strongly implies direct work on the generated artifact, but that part of the structural signature is less fully documented than it is for CounterQuill.
